title: Jacob's Blessings
intro: On his deathbed, Jacob gathered his sons and prophesied over each of them. These words shaped Israel's 12 tribes.

persons.name: Reuben
persons.description: Firstborn, but lost his birthright due to sin with his father's concubine.

persons.name: Simeon
persons.description: Scattered in Israel because of violence. The tribe was later absorbed into Judah.

persons.name: Levi
persons.description: Scattered in Israel, but became the priestly tribe. Did not receive its own territory.

persons.name: Judah
persons.description: The lion of Judah. The royal tribe from which David and Jesus came.

persons.name: Zebulun
persons.description: Would dwell by the seashore and become a harbor for ships.

persons.name: Issachar
persons.description: Compared to a strong donkey that bows under its burden.

persons.name: Dan
persons.description: Would judge his people. Compared to a snake by the road.

persons.name: Gad
persons.description: Would be attacked by raiding bands, but would attack them at their heels.

persons.name: Asher
persons.description: Would have rich food and provide royal delicacies.

persons.name: Naphtali
persons.description: A deer set free that speaks beautiful words.

persons.name: Joseph
persons.description: The most blessed. A fruitful tree by a spring, blessed by heaven and earth.

persons.name: Benjamin
persons.description: A ravenous wolf that devours its prey in the morning and divides the spoil in the evening.
